Paragraph: "See those cuckoos calling from the tops of the mango trees laden with blossoms! Their songs echo through the hills like notes of celebration..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hearing birdsong reverberating through the mango groves.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama points out the musical resonance of nature in the hilly terrain.
Outcome/Resolution: He focuses on the acoustic beauty of the forest environment.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Dhvani (Resonant sound evoking emotional and spiritual states)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The echoing calls of cuckoos symbolize the natural vibration (Dhvani) of the universe calling all beings to spiritual awakening.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Directing sensory attention to external acoustic stimuli to manage internal intrusive thoughts.
